never.note: “I think that” is a hedge: words that soften a statement. Cut it and state the thing.
“basically” is a hedge: words that soften a statement. Cut it and state the thing.
“due to the fact that” is a stock phrase: several words where one will do. Write “because”.
“very” is an intensifier: a word that strengthens the word after it. Cut it, or choose a stronger word.
“not honest” says what is not so. Positive form says what is: write “dishonest”.
“In order to” is a stock phrase: several words where one will do. Write “to”.
“really” is an intensifier: a word that strengthens the word after it. Cut it, or choose a stronger word.
“on a daily basis” is a stock phrase: several words where one will do. Write “daily”.
